part_qualification: PART immediately followed by GENITIVE within same prose block; only then typed material
continuation_rule: Most recent prior FLOW in same block; retain that FLOW material binding, never update it retroactively from a later material mention.
resets: every declared prose frame and every label; no sentence boundaries inferred from physical lines or unknown groups
gap_policy: Keep all intervening raw groups, types, nominal competitors and copulas. Unknowns are unchecked, not neutral.
